behavior: A part keeps its own value of an attribute when the consumer gives that attribute the value `undefined`, as Vue keeps the default of a declared prop. `null` removes the value of the part. The attribute types of a part accept `null`, except an attribute that reaches a declared prop that takes no `null`. A wrapper that passes an optional prop on, such as `:aria-labelledby="labelledby"`, thus keeps the accessible name of a dialog and `type="button"` of a button. In Base UI, `undefined` replaces the value of the part and removes the attribute. Base UI keeps the value of the part for `undefined` only for an event handler, `className` and `style`. The parts of Input, Field, Fieldset, Form, Checkbox, Checkbox Group, Radio, Radio Group, Switch and Meter give each attribute of the developer to the element as it is.
